title: multiple scalars to colors
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate multiple scalars-to-colors items in separate chart viewports.

**dataset → plot → chart → item → context_asset → renderer → infrastructure → output**

- [vtkChartXY](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkChartXY.html) — chart xy.
- [vtkColorTransferFunction](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkColorTransferFunction.html) — maps scalar values to RGB colors for volume rendering.
- [vtkColorTransferFunctionItem](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkColorTransferFunctionItem.html) — color transfer function item.
- [vtkCompositeTransferFunctionItem](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCompositeTransferFunctionItem.html) — composite transfer function item.
- [vtkContextActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkContextActor.html) — context actor.
- [vtkContextScene](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkContextScene.html) — context scene.
- [vtkDoubleArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDoubleArray.html) — double array.
- [vtkLookupTable](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLookupTable.html) — maps scalar values to colors.
- [vtkLookupTableItem](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLookupTableItem.html) — lookup table item.
- [vtkPiecewiseControlPointsItem](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPiecewiseControlPointsItem.html) — piecewise control points item.
- [vtkPiecewiseFunction](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPiecewiseFunction.html) — defines a piecewise linear scalar-to-opacity mapping.
- [vtkPiecewiseFunctionItem](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPiecewiseFunctionItem.html) — piecewise function item.
- [vtkTable](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTable.html) — table.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
